# Binghamton Floodwatch
> Independent Binghamton basin monitoring. Not an official warning service.

- [Dashboard](https://binghamton-flood-dashboard-production.up.railway.app/): River observations, official forecasts, alerts, cameras, community reports and source freshness.
- [NWS Binghamton](https://www.weather.gov/bgm/): Official weather and safety guidance.
- [NOAA NWPS](https://water.noaa.gov/wfo/bgm): Official river forecasts and basin map.
- [USGS](https://waterservices.usgs.gov/): River observations.

Never treat an unavailable or stale feed as evidence of safety. Gauge stages use local datums. Point precipitation forecasts are not basin averages. Camera retrieval time is not capture time.
